Insulin Degludec in Critically Ill Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Prospective Interventional Study. Dysglycemia has deleterious outcomes on critically ill patients with diabetes mellitus (DM). Insulin degludec, an ultralong-acting insulin, is associated with lower rates of hypoglycemia and blood glucose (BG) variability in non-critically ill patients.
